{{Youmay|Fishing trawler|[[Swilla Corey]]}}
'''''Swilla''''' was a [[222 fishing trawler]] operating in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. Before becoming a [[Constable/Legends|constable]] c. [[69 BBY/Legends|69 BBY]], [[Mix Liddell]] worked on ''Swilla'' as harpoon person.
